files.assessment: Exact node identities/counts, cycle/self-loop/external and missing endpoints, diagnostics and adapter results constrain synthetic fixtures. Repeated-call equality tests determinism; it is supplemented by independent expectations. These are fixture contracts, not graph UI or runtime dependency semantics.

Trusted subscription observations keep the generation; switching to API-key rotates it; unknown invalidates with untrusted_lifecycle; rebound differs from both previous values; stopped clears. Named owner is actually stopped/recreated and same-mode observation gets a new generation. This is owner restart coverage, not full daemon restart.

Private owner/store with fixed clock, via support helper. Malformed account-mode/header payload retains same-generation 83% as stale and a valid 42% update recovers. Valid mode change rotates and removes old window facts; unknown classification clears generation/windows. Cross-provider writes leave Claude snapshot unchanged. Injected rejection/failure-recorder errors are surfaced. Exact redacted-message shape excludes correlations; no live provider request.

Actual cat ports and recorded StreamDiagnostics exercise direct turn/failed handling. Structured rate limits and diagnostic session-limit text pause; unrelated diagnostic remains error. Ports have on_exit cleanup in addition to success cleanup. This is handler classification, not scheduler pause/resume or provider execution.

Workflow-backed accessor checks nil model, explicit model, default command, permission defaults, valid acceptEdits and invalid-value fallback to bypassPermissions. Preserve or explicitly reconsider permissive fallback in the package contract; tests characterize configuration, not authorization enforcement.

Synthetic JSONL with real supervised tailer and manual polls tests history backfill, session retargeting, missing-path recovery, killed inner-tailer health with opaque logging, malformed-line skip and explicit backfill/live ingress. Cold-start operator request IDs deduplicate then flush to exact session; unresolved buffer retains newest 32 of 40. Owner process exit is monitored to normal tailer DOWN. Body cap requires truncation marker and <2000 bytes for max_body 1000, not an exact bound. Display callbacks do not prove TUI rendering. First test says in order but assertions only check role/body membership; follow-up candidate retained pending cross-suite context.

Lifecycle/unknown normalization, optional fields and nonbinary-to-nil cases, actual subscribed dispatch and per-identifier exclusion. Malformed dispatch returns ok. Does not exercise HTTP ingress or a running Claude hook.

Restores injected dashboard URL provider; exact set of four hook names; endpoint sampled from StopFailure. Shell-command substring checks require timeout/silencing/header/exit suffix and normalized slash; does not execute curl or prove wall-clock bound/exit behavior. Write test decodes actual JSON and cleans generated path.

Structured and textual limit classifications have negative ordinary-crash/stack-line-429 controls. Prose reset extraction, structured reset priority, timezone-resolved provider refusal, missing reset nil, 404/529 and banner-without-provider-provenance rejection are explicit. These finite fixtures are not exhaustive language parsing or current provider protocol validation.

Pinned fixture normalization carries provider/backend/source/version and reported quota only. Unknown status with quota/reset omitted stays unknown and absent, not zero. Reconciler refresh at reset+1 makes health/window stale. Concrete drift/range/unknown-field and legacy/OTel rejection cases, plus fixture forbidden-substring checks. Test title every non-allowlisted field is broader than finite examples; do not report exhaustive privacy proof.

Real adapter ports talk to scripted shell app-servers. Workspace/base/telemetry env, model override, dynamic tool advertisement, invocation identity, tool replies and 110KiB spill file round-trip are asserted. Two sessions coexist but turns run sequentially; the shared frame check sorts model values, not per-session identity. Closed port and exit-1 failures remain clean errors. Meter ingestion and redacted callbacks are injected. Provider refusal pauses preserve retry counts, record reset (including controlled atomic-rename failure), respect global/label/operator holds, and resume at reset through direct reconcile; entry lacks a generation and expects legacy two-tuple resume. Later unrelated crashes, stale/quoted/tool banners and assistant-only banner do not inherit quota classification. No actual Claude service, full controller run or rendered UI exercised.

Mixes real OS and injected boundaries: live BEAM procfs identity, actual sleep process-group pidfd reap, trap-installed readiness before delayed TERM wait, real distinct child found through pgrep, and group cleanup after leader exits. Identity-change barrier uses injected reaper, not a real PID-reuse race. Private trust JSON preserves sibling keys. Fake procfs with injected kill tests strict descendant cwd, protected self tree, shallow-root refusal, later-appearing process resweep and bounded exhausted warning. real_proc scenario uses real procfs and inside/outside sleepers, not launcher stop end-to-end. Its cwd wait exhausts as ok and inside sleeper lacks fallback cleanup if reap fails; retain as failure-path hygiene candidate, not proven leak. No real RC service attachment.

Mostly shell-text construction checks: success chain, credential scrub before exec, configured base quoting, flag order and absent optional flags. Failed-workspace case actually runs bash with stub claude and requires nonzero/no launch/no token output; successful launch credential removal is not exercised here. Resume ID requires private transcript existence. Hook-settings environment-dependent case accepts nil or binary and only constrains nonraising return shape.

Tmux mock command/reply handshake tests readiness timeout cleanup, failure retention when pane kill fails, successful non-RC session metadata and both ProcessReaper registrations, unavailable RC attach cleanup, and missing hook listener rejected before any tmux output. Fabricated teardown PIDs have host probes/signals stubbed in failure cases. Readiness/RC remain injected pane text; no live tmux/Claude. Serial application-env override is restored by put_env (absent becomes nil). receive_barrier and Task.await infinity do not provide a local bounded failure deadline.

Mock paste/pane/interrupt plus actual HookEvents dispatch. Successful Ctrl+C returns correlated pause request; failed interrupt returns error, not paused. Silent timeout, repeated heartbeat extension, provider-hook-only delivery acknowledgement, raw session ID versus synthetic display fallback, structured StopFailure quota versus ordinary auth failure/assistant prose preserved. Heartbeat timing uses wall-clock sleeps; helper drain recursion has no overall local deadline. No HTTP hook transport, provider or UI verification.

Mock literal send-keys followed by Enter; newline/control sanitization, all-control empty/no send, invalid payload/session, Ctrl+C, immediate success callback and missing-tmux failure callback, noop. A success request ID demonstrates transport command completion, not provider acceptance or persisted delivery. Sanitization sample asserts no newline and matching printable text but does not exhaustively inspect every control byte.

Preserve distinct submission contracts: hook/RC path never clears input and sends Enter best-effort even after echo timeout; transcript path clears/retypes missing echo and returns prompt_not_delivered without Enter on timeout. Mock command response sequencing drives actual function paths; paste chip/prefix are fabricated observations. Drain rejects unexpected clear commands until completion marker; not manual TUI testing.

Mock banner immediate URL and footer-driven /rc, Enter, dialog scrape then Escape. Timeout still dismisses dialog and yields nil; no evidence at zero budget nil. These characterize text/command protocol, not real service availability; fixed captured/fabricated strings may drift independently.

Callback envelope preserves event/session/thread/turn details, DateTime timestamp, and nested transcript without flattening type. Title says merges event/timestamp over details but supplied details contain no colliding event/timestamp; exact overwrite precedence is not constrained by these fixtures.

scope_note: Source review only; no production edits, full suite, live provider or manual UI verification. Supporting claude_meter_test_support.exs read separately and not counted in this unit.

follow_up_candidates.hypothesis: The full-conversation test name claims ordering, but its oracle checks membership only and accepts reordered forwarded events.
follow_up_candidates.next: Extract the actual assertions for a bounded permutation probe, check other transcript tests for order coverage, and distinguish a local oracle gap from an end-to-end ordering defect.

follow_up_candidates.hypothesis: The real-proc test has fallback kill only for outside sleeper; a failed inside reap can leave the fixture until its 300-second lifetime ends. Readiness helper returns ok on exhaustion.
follow_up_candidates.next: Check enclosing cleanup and demonstrate only with isolated owned children before promoting; do not run live workspace sweeps.
